ModMetaData.name: Colony Scale
ModMetaData.author: UrekD
ModMetaData.description:
Behaviour-preserving performance patches for large colonies (many colonists, animals, mechs, entities and items).
Every optimization can be toggled in the mod settings. Each patched game method is fingerprinted: after a game update, any optimization whose target changed disables itself instead of risking a broken game.
Dev mode adds an A/B benchmark (Debug actions → Colony Scale) that measures ms per tick with the optimizations off and on.
Requires Harmony 2.4 or newer; with an older Harmony every optimization stays off and the mod settings say why.
